fields.title: 📖 Whoever forgets a portion of the reminder
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“The covenant was also taken from those who said they were Christians; then they forgot a portion of that with which they had been reminded.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** A Dīn is damaged not only by open rejection, but also by the selective forgetting of the revealed duties.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:14.
